fix: Three parts. (1) Land the embedded codex-tmux.json exhausted_regex fix (drop the bare `rate.?limit` token — the live override at .evolve/bridge-manifests/codex-tmux.json carries the corrected pattern `(?i)(limit reached|hit your (usage|rate) limit|\b0%\s*left|too many requests|quota exceeded)`; the embedded copy must match, then the override can be retired). (2) Regression test in internal/bridge: a HEALTHY /status pane fixture containing the display vocabulary ('Rate limits', '5h limit: 88% left', 'weekly limit') must NOT classify exhausted for ANY family's pattern; a genuine wall fixture ('limit reached', '0% left') must. This is generation 6 of the quota-wording-drift class — the fixture pins display-vocabulary vs wall-vocabulary separation structurally. (3) BenchWall claims to 'keep the evidence line' but the stored bench entry carries NO evidence field — persist the matched pane line into the bench JSON so a false bench is diagnosable from state instead of requiring a live re-probe.
